title: Game Profile
description: Complete editor profile for a single football game on a single platform. Captures release info, editor capabilities, grid specifications, limits, quirks, and verification status.

era.description: Hardware era grouping (for filtering across generations).

custom_play_support.description: True if the game has a create-a-play editor; false if not.

custom_formation_support.description: True if the game has a create-a-formation editor; false if not.

grid.description: Editor grid dimensions (null if no editor). Contains width, height, and origin.

origin.description: Origin cell (where the LOS/ball is). Coordinates are 0-indexed.

scale.description: Conversion from grid cells to real yards (null if no editor).

snap_to_cells.description: True if editor snaps player positions to grid cells; false if free positioning allowed (null if no editor).

limits.description: Editor capability limits (null if no editor). Well-known keys documented; custom keys allowed.

max_route_depth_yd.description: Maximum receiver route depth in yards.

max_player_split_yd.description: Maximum horizontal split width in yards.

playbook_caps.description: Playbook and play count limits (null if no editor).

engine_quirks.description: Known engine behaviors, bugs, or limitations affecting play design.

default_playbooks.description: Names of built-in playbooks (e.g. 'Bill Belichick (Patriots)', 'Mike Holmgren (Eagles)'). May be partial list.

verification_status.description: Verified = measured in-game or from official docs; inferred = from related games; unverified = incomplete.

source_notes.description: Web-validated citations for each claim in this profile.
